title: Open the cash register
summary: Open the day's cash session by counting the opening cash. If a cash register is already open, it first guides the closing.

steps.title: Menu → Cashier → Cashier
steps.details: Today's cash register: opening, movements and closing.

steps.title: The cash register is already open
steps.details: To open a new one this one has to be closed first: I'll guide you through closing it and then through opening.

steps.title: Start closing
steps.details: Closing goes in steps: review, count, deposit, cash count and report.

steps.title: Review the session
steps.details: Opening amount, cash on hand, income, expenses and POS per currency. Transactions lists each movement.

steps.title: Next
steps.details: Moves on to the count.

steps.title: Count the cash
steps.details: Count what's physically in the cash register, bill by bill. The difference with what the system says shows in the cash count.

steps.title: Next
steps.details: Once for each currency.

steps.title: Bank deposit (optional)
steps.details: If you take cash out to deposit at the bank, count what goes out and attach the receipt. If not, continue.

steps.title: Cash count
steps.details: Per currency and payment method: system total, declared and difference (red if short, green if over).

steps.title: Closing notes
steps.details: Explain any difference: it stays in the report.

steps.title: Closing report
steps.details: Print it for the handover; it stays in Cashier → Sessions.

steps.title: Menu → Cashier → Cashier
steps.details: Today's cash register: opening, movements and closing.

steps.title: Choose the cash register to open
steps.details: Each physical cash register (front desk, another branch) is opened separately. If you already have a cash register open, the others are disabled.

steps.title: Exchange rate
steps.details: Only if the clinic works with two currencies: today's exchange rate to convert between them. It's fetched automatically; you can correct it.

steps.title: Main currency
steps.details: The currency the cash register is kept in.

steps.title: Next
steps.details: Moves on to counting the cash.

steps.title: Count the opening cash
steps.details: How many bills and coins of each denomination are in the cash register when opening; the total shows at the top. «Fill with last closing» copies what was left at the previous closing; «Fill with 0» if the cash register starts empty.

steps.title: Next
steps.details: If there's more than one currency, each one is counted.

steps.title: Review the opening
steps.details: Cash register, user, date, currency, exchange rate and the total counted per currency (with its breakdown).

steps.title: Confirm and open
steps.details: From now on payments, provider payments and miscellaneous movements are recorded in this cash register.
